concept.core_mechanic: small vulnerable being in front, protector/power presence looming behind
concept.composition: protagonist and vulnerable creature/child occupy the lower-center third; protector or transformed creature fills the upper/background third; eyes or energy connect them
concept.emotion: fear turning into trust; protector intensity without sexualized coercion
concept.palette: warm gold/cyan or warm gold/ice-blue contrast; luminous subject separation from darker background
concept.text_direction: short concrete promise, 2–5 words maximum if text is used; do not restate a long title
concept.mobile_test: at 160px wide, viewer must still identify the small creature/child, protagonist emotion, and protector silhouette
concept.source_promise: A cinematic creature-protection fantasy: visible vulnerable dragon child, costly protective love, injustice and public reversal, storm-scale spectacle, and a warm found-family/belonging payoff.
concept.source_wound: Mira was publicly branded a traitor after a nursery fire she did not start, losing her home, rank, and every creature she loved.

opening_rules: show the vulnerable creature/child or immediate threat within 90 seconds
tie spectacle to protection rather than scale alone
pay the creature bond visually in the first 5 minutes
when scale is central, frame the powerful creature/giant as a misunderstood protector or parent rather than spectacle alone
for compressed 10-35 minute versions, use one dominant protection question and make every scene perform at least two jobs: danger, bonding, cost, or reversal

mixed_pipeline_example.assumption: 70% cheap draft/blocking lane at $0.02/sec, 20% mid-cost lane at $0.05/sec, 10% hero-shot lane at $0.12/sec

warnings: iteration ratio is a planning assumption, not a measurement
input/reference video billing can increase cost on some providers
voice, music, edit, QA, and labor are excluded
recheck exact provider pricing/terms before any spend
production_rules: do not generate the full film linearly; decompose into shots
validate character consistency with a cheap fixed smoke pack first
use expensive models only for hero/motion-critical shots
track actual generated seconds vs final seconds as a KPI

meaning_carrier_intelligence.craft_rule: A physical object, space, sound-object, or ritual should carry the wound in the opening and return with changed meaning in the payoff.

fields.power_asymmetry: The navy can weaponize the dragon child through pain, while Mira alone understands that safety controls its stormcall.
fields.safety_or_kindness_before_power: Mira frees and shields the child before she knows whether it can help her, and calms it through care rather than command.
fields.costly_protagonist_action: She exposes her hidden identity, loses her refuge, spends her last royal token on villagers, and enters the vault publicly.
fields.consent_or_personhood_repair: She refuses to use the child even to win; the creatures remain free by treaty, and trust replaces command.
fields.payoff_image: child and parent fly freely through a sunlit stormglass arch while Mira chooses communal coastal belonging over rank

relational_contract_intelligence.craft_rule: Power-asymmetric relationships are strongest when safety or costly kindness precedes power, and the ending repairs consent/personhood rather than rewarding coercion.

spatial_status_intelligence.doctrine: Define who is physically forced below/outside/inside power, then make the ending transform that space into chosen access, sanctuary, or belonging. Inspired by floor/table and cage/sanctuary evidence.

closure_integrity.craft_rule: A plot sequel hook may remain, but only after the promised recognition, home, belonging, and community consequence have landed.
